historical_forecast_error.usage_note: EBIT- or EBITDA-level shock today: error_per_forecast_revenue × today's revenue consensus. Exact identity: error_per_forecast_revenue = ratio_error + (actual ÷ actual revenue) × (actual revenue ÷ forecast revenue − 1).
